sources.scope: PDF text/geometry observations reuse existing managed foundation; source actions remain passive.

decisions: Original RTF control parsing and XML/package serialization expose explicit finite source profiles; no complete RTF/ISO29500/binary Word conformance claim is inferred from schema or declaration checks.
Independent Word97 piece-table interpretation is bounded to the original generated documents; unsupported document structures and full corpus validation remain mandatory.
Exact PNG pixels from an original synthetic renderer prove serialization/geometry contracts, not actual engine rendering or Word pagination/visual fidelity.
Explicit recovered Unicode and inferred page paragraphs carry distinct provenance; full editable reconstruction and fixed-layout fidelity remain mandatory.
